summary.text: Beau Bayh is the Democratic nominee for Secretary of State. A first-time candidate and Indianapolis attorney, he is a Marine Corps veteran and the son of former Gov. and Sen. Evan Bayh.

paragraphs.text: Earned a bachelor's degree in government and a law degree from Harvard University; served as a captain and infantry officer in the U.S. Marine Corps.
Worked as an attorney in Indianapolis; had not previously run for office.
